text: Holliday "Burgundy" Hall is a tenth generation Hecata through the Harbingers of Ashur bloodline.
Hollow Men (also known as Nix, the Forlorn, and Adurra) are strange spirits that are known to target societies.
Horatio Sims is part of the Mouse Clan and leader of the Daher pack.
Hollie Silvertooth is a Storm Lord Rahu member of the Skyfire pack in Chicago.

Horned Serpent is the Patron Spirit of the Ghost Council tribe of Garou. Some scholars of Umbral esoterica give her the more neutral 'name' of the Principle of Twisting Secrets. (For her counterpart in older editions, see Uktena.)
"Doc" Holly David is a Euthanatos mage and member of the Black Pyramid Chantry in Las Vegas.
A Howling Shambler is a Garou fomori possessed by a Howling Insanity Bane.
Hugo Eames is a Banu Haqim of the Preservationist Assamites. He served as ambassador and attaché under Fatima al-Faqadi in Singapore.
Horatio Drake is a British Ventrue of the London Camarilla and the childe of Colville.
Ilias cel Frumos ("the Beautiful") was a Tzimisce Sinner and koldun during the Dark Ages, and a lover to Myca Vykos.

Ifa (ee-FAH), or Orunmila (aw-ROON-mee-lah) is the oldest son of the supreme Orisha Olorun and the Orisha of divination. He is a diviner and designed the world to run smoothly and so that those who practice the arts of divination can glimpse those secret workings.
Igrania is a Seelie Sidhe Wilder of House Gwydion in the Kingdom of Willows.
Hung Doi Pham is a Null Mysteriis Hunter from South Philadelphia. His family is wolf-blooded.
Ilduara is a Hecata and Harbinger of Skulls elder, and the sire of Holliday Hall.

Ingrid Brown was a notorious Nephandus who kept her nature entirely secret from her sleeper family. When her grandson Winston Awakened, however, the two came into conflict and Ingrid murdered Winston's wife Evelyn. Winston dedicated the rest of his life to revenge on his grandmother, and may have found it in the Sebel-el-Mafough Whash, an ancient text of Babylonian magic.
Ishaq Ibn-Thoth (Born Ishaq Balsara) is an Archmage and Primus of House Quaesitor who travels this world and many others in pursuit of the Order of Hermes' justice.
Isaiah English is a Ghost Wolf Rahu member of the Dog Boys pack in Chicago.
Isabella Cojuangco is an autarkis ancilla (based on her Disciplines and general disposition, most likely a Ventrue) inhabiting Bellium University.
Inzibael is a Scourge in Los Angeles. Inzibael is possessing the body of a mortal known as Andrew Lau.
Inana is a Defiler and Minister of Aurochs to the Blood Court of Los Angeles. Inana is possessing the body of a mortal known as Carmen Esparza.
Irshemesh is a Slayer in Los Angeles. Irshemesh is possessing the body of a mortal known as Nigel Moorcock.
Inaroth is a Scrouge. She is currently possessing the body of a mortal known as Rebecca Windsor.
Indrahi is a Defiler. He is possessing the body of a mortal known as Billy Rohan.
Isadora Genevieve Parantio is a Roman Lasombra of the Dark Ages, and the lover of Alfonzo of Venice. She was assassinated by the Chosen of Calomena in Constantinople.

Jane Kennedy is a Board Member and major stockholder in the Orpheus Group projection firm. She was also one of the company's first clients when it was JDG Cryogenics. Kennedy married into the famous Kennedy family, only to divorce her husband in 1982, receiving a generous settlement in the process. She attempted to run for office, but instead found herself facing terminal cancer. Using her settlement, she opted to be cryogenically frozen until a cure could be found. While in a suspended state, Kennedy found herself having out-of-body experiences where she eavesdropped on conversations and met ghosts. When she was thawed and treated in 1991, she reported her experiences to her doctors. After

Iturya was the partner of Blaysiel. In Heaven, she was known as the Angel of the Blessed Homecoming and was responsible for creating destinations. She was among the Fallen during the Fall. After the Sixth Great Maelstrom, she escaped Hell and began to search for Blaysiel, but was devoured by Blaysiel's Earthbound master.

: Jacob the Glitch was an amnesiac Tremere antitribu of Montréal, where he was a member of the Librarians coven. He was a small, mousy Afro-Caribbean man in disheveled clothes, who always looked confused and befuddled.

The werewolf can cause technological devices to cease functioning, albeit temporarily. Even the simplest of shaped objects will refuse to perform its function. (See also Native Gifts for the Fifth Edition version of this Gift.) System: The player spends one Gnosis point and rolls Manipulation + Crafts. The werewolf may choose the level of complexity she intends to “jam.” All technological devices (i.e., any devices shaped from fabricated materials like metal or plastic) of that complexity within 50 feet cease functioning for one turn per success. The devices remain unchanged but inert. Knives won’t cut, gunpowder won’t ignite, gears won’t turn, and so on. The difficulty of the roll is based
James Spencer (Shanachie) is an Ojo Eshu Wilder who roams the island of Hibernia.
Jacob "Hunter" Bournell is a mage of the Virtual Adepts, specifically Cypherpunk faction. He is considered to be one of the premier Cypherpunks of his generation for his great skill and intelligence.
Jabar is a sixth generation Brujah and the sire of the loner Sultan Usama ibn Jabar, active in the Medieval period.

"Mad" Jack Dunbar was an occultist noble and member of the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Protestant_Ascendancy Protestant Ascendancy] who owned large swaths of Irish land in the 1700s, most notably Glenkildove and the surrounding areas of the Wicklow Mountains.
Jahi is a Fiend in Los Angeles. Jahi is possessing a mortal known as Sally Finn.
Jahaleel is a Slayer in Los Angeles. Jahaleel is possessing the body of a mortal known as Isabella Lind.
Izrafhil is a renegade Slayer in Los Angeles. Izrafhil is possessing the body of a mortal known as Diana Fowler.
Jadrax, Fiend of Secrets is a Demonic Spirit and of the Tempter rank. Note: This is a Demon before the Demon: The Fallen game setting.
James Daniel Conolly (formerly Agent X234512) is a Orphan Mage.
Jacque Amyzial is a twelfth generation Setite of Washington, D.C.
Jacob Schumpeter is an 8th generation Ventrue of Chicago, a childe of Prince Lodin.

Jean Chastel was a farmer and inn-keeper from the province of Gévaudan in France and a Shadow Lord Kinfolk. He killed the infamous Blackfang, the "Beast of Gévaudan", with a silver bullet on June 18, 1787 CE.

Jenna Cross is the leader of the Thin-blood vampire movement in Los Angeles. During the Final Nights, she created a thin-blooded empire, bringing thin-bloods from all over the world to L.A. to help against the Camarilla and the various Anarchs fighting over control of the city.
Dr. Jeffrey Granger is an 12th generation Malkavian resident of Washington, D.C..
Jean Lisle (a corruption of l'Isle) is a monstrous Samedi sealed into an urn that found its way to Gary, Indiana.
Princess Jessamy is an Unseelie Sidhe Childling of House Ailil.
Jason "Tycho" Champlain is a Iron Master Ithaeur member of the Silver Syndicate Pack in Colorado.

Janis Wakefield is a Tremere and childe of the former Regent John Reiss. She is is a leading figure in the Hartford Chantry. She is very loyal to the new Regent, Deneb Osborne, and is a powerful mind-control specialist.
Jara Drory is the Nosferatu Primogen of Boston. She was a former Redcoat of the Triad, and an agent of the Web spy network. Due to her past allegiances, she sought Prince Hazel Iversen's trust.
Jean-Michel du Pont-Ville is a powerful tenth-generation Tremere of Cleveland.

Jennifer Rees is an eleventh generation Tremere and the sire of Sun Che. She is the Regent of Toronto and she welcomed Sun Che into her coven until she embraced her and uncovered Che's bloodlust. Her interest in the childe diminished and Sun Che eventually left for Chicago.
Jessica Young is a former Void Engineer Mage and barkeep of Spy's Demise.
Janet Wolf is a Son of Ether mage. She is the leader of the Jupiter's Forge Cabal.
Jerry Tanner is a Dreamspeaker mage and member of the Big Springs Chantry in Las Vegas.
Johann is a powerful Toreador elder of Berlin and the leader of the local Toreador, before World War II.
Joachim von Neumann is a powerful Ventrue of Paris, during the 18th century. He was sworn to protect the secrets of the Nosferatu Zelios.
Janosz Brusche is a Doppelganger featured in the Last Danse Macabre adventure in Ends of Empire.
Javaniel is a Fifth Generation Salubri methuselah and the childe of Yavok.

Johann Kloepfer was a Tremere and a member of the Cologne Chantry who authored the Das Tiefe Geheimnis in the 15th century. An important tome about Thaumaturgy, his work lays the foundations for the basic principles of Thaumaturgy, but glaring errors in Kloepfer's explanations, such as omitting vital steps in common rituals, make the work useful only in a supplemental capacity. Many magi believe Kloepfer placed these fallacies deliberately to safeguard the art from non-initiates. Most chantry copies are littered with copious hand-written notes and corrections added by respective members over the centuries.
Jean-Paul Joreau is Order of Hermes barabbi of House Tytalus.
Jeremiah Saha is a British Ventrue neonate and the childe and underling of Adrian Yu.

Jun Yow is a Kuei-jin residing in Hong Kong and follows the the Way of the Resplendent Crane. She is the main opposition to the Ancestor Anguo Chun. She stays in where she can keep a watch on Hong Kong Island.
Jorge De La Muerte is a Seventh Generation Samedi who was Embraced in 1732.
Joseph van Nocenti III is a Dauntain of the Black Magician Doom.
Johannes Agrippa was a powerful sorcerer who founded the Ancient Order of the Aeon Rites.
Journals of Bone, also known as the Annals of Pestilence, are the transcribed utterances of the Skeletal Lord.
Julia Sowinski is a Lasombra neonate and the young Primogen of New York City. She is the protagonist of Vampire: The Masquerade - Shadows of New York.
John Bullock was a seventh generation Nosferatu that lived in London. He embraced Clive Cooper shortly before being blood hunted in 1884.

John Weaver was a Snow courtier who lived in sixteenth century London. An oneiromancer of some renown, Weaver was the first to notice the plague-bearing incubus known as the Pale Horse, which began spreading bubonic plague in spring of 1593. Though Weaver did not survive long, being the first victim, his notes were instrumental in tracking down and eliminating the incubus.

Julia Marie Saint was a human who was made the host of a bhüta. Said ghost used her body to commit cannibalism, an act that saw her arrested. During her interrogation by officers Nathan Cord and Robert Markan, the bhüta left Saint's body to invade Markan's, at which point the body finally gave out and died.
John Bedford, currently soulless, is the founder of the occult organization the Bedford Hermetic Coalition.

Journey was born in Boston in 1904. She was from a long line of musicians and took to the stage with her parents at a young age. She joined the violin section at the New England Conservatory of Music. Journey showed great talent and could play in any style. After completing her studies and graduating with honors, she opted for a career teaching at the conservatory that trained her. There she became the president of the alumni association, with the important role of granting awards and scholarships and organizing events. It was at one of these gatherings that she would meet Zitkála-Šá, an honorary alumni, whose career fascinated her. The interest revealed itself to be mutual, and a strange fr

Captain Jonas Cardoza is an eighth generation Lasombra from Spain, and one of the candidates to sire Anne Bowesley in the 17th century. Captain Jonas appears to be a respectable Spanish merchant captain, though he occasionally serves as privateer for the crown. He was impressed with Lady Anne's ruthlessness and she in turn is as intrigued by the Lasombra. Captain Jonas is an arrogant swaggering swordsman who finds the whole affair rather amusing. If he can't claim Lady Anne, he will at least enjoy annoying the Camarilla and the Ventrue, which is a win for him.
Kandy Kaine, born Candance Craine, is one of the few remaining Sabbat in New York City.
Karif al-Numair was one of the founding members of the Black Hand within the Sabbat, and the first hulul to lead the Assamite antitribu.
Kehetkhat was one of the Shan'iatu and one of the heads of the deceived Akhem-Urtu Guild. He is also referred to as the Dancer and his domain were the physical arts, the most prominent being dance.
Kay Polerno is a 9th generation neonate of the Giovanni clan.
Duchess Kali and Duke Siva are Unseelie Sidhe Wilders and rulers of the Duchy of Shadows in Washington, D.C.
Kassiym Malikhair is a Kiasyd. He sired Beatrice L'Angou to repay a boon from Alfred Benezri.
Kalfu is one of the Loa, the twin of Legba and god of the night.
Kaius Leto is a Nosferatu of Boston and the security expert of the Boston Camarilla.
Kel Asuf is a Devil. He is possessing the body of a mortal known as Milo Coltraine.
Karl Johansen is the Tremere Regent of Rio de Janeiro. He supported the Embrace of Almiro Suarez, to help his coterie track a local Kindred cult with his modern insight.
Kai Walch is a powerful German Gangrel and the childe of Sonja.
Kevin Harvey was a twelfth generation Malkavian and the childe of Andrea Harvey-Staboli.

Quiet and unseen, but omnipresent, the vampires derided as mere servants bear a far more important heritage and duty than even they know. Their unique Obtenebration Discipline is only a hint of their higher calling. The Khaibit are a bloodline of the Mekhet clan, a lineage that originated in ancient cults worshiping the Egyptian god Set. Their role was to assist their "Dark Lord" in keeping back the even more ancient powers of darkness; they were warriors who made darkness a weapon against the forces who would spring from it. In modern nights, however, they have all but forgotten their purpose, and the majority of Khaibit - at least until recently - act as servants and bodyguards in the Circ
The Khavi (or Khazi), are a revenant line that was bred by Byelobog, and served only him.

Kotoyesi is the Kithain ruler of the Kingdom of Ife and the greatest living Eshu on Earth. It is he who, through his Ifa, saw the disappearance of High King David Ardry and tried to warn the Kingdom of Concordia, too no avail.

Khurshid, the wearer of the Sun Mask, was a Persian warlord of in life as well as death, making for a peculiar necromancer among his scholarly brethren. His abilities both on the battlefield and in courtroom diplomacy are renowned. He compelled the Clan of the Hidden to wage a century-long civil war for his personal, necromantic benefit. Khurshid was believed entombed in Kaymakli during the Feast of Folly, but a Harbinger of Skulls has appeared in modern nights claiming the ancient strategist's identity.
Knight Entropy, also known as the Wyrm’s Spawn and Knight Entropic, is a Maeljin Incarna of the Urge Wyrm of Consumption.

Kito Sullivan is a Hong Kong mage. Owner and operator of Childplay Games, a small company that is designed to introduce young children to the joys of the virtual world, he is also a member of the Virtual Adepts. His company headquarters is located on the outskirts of Kowloon, and Kito generally can be found there or at his cottage on Lantau Island.
Kitalid the Deceiver is a Bane that likes to possess children.
Killikillarven is an ex-shaman Malkavian notable for developing a Thaumaturgical Path called Spirit Thaumaturgy. He appeared as an SPC in The Succubus Club.
Kieran Leary is an aging New York City homicide detective who, despite being incapable of perceiving spirits, has some awareness of taint within the Shadow.
Kiaria "Glass" Welch is a Iron Master Ithaeur member of the Lake Howlers pack in Chicago.
Kli Kodesh is an Israelite Nosferatu methuselah and a wandering doomsayer and prophet.
Korbin Salamanca is a Tremere of southern California and the sire of Joseph Ravenfeather.
Khin Aye is a powerful Ventrue antitribu and a Sabbat Priscus.
Khabiri is a Setite elder and the sire of the High Priestess Ravenna.
Khalid al-Munir is a powerful Assamite of the Sorcerer Caste.
The Laughing Lady was one of the Deathlords of Stygia. She oversaw the Penitent Legion, which was dominated by those who died while insane or because of insanity.

Lamachis the Devourer, also known as Lachesis the Devourer, was one of the most active Onceborn Malfeans known. Taking the form of an ancient crone with a giant pair of scissors, Lamachis alleged to be the true Lady of Fate and the one who ultimately controls the threads of Fate in a manner similar to the legendary of Greek mythology.
Lawrence Ballard was the childe of Horatio Ballard. He was a 9th generation Ventrue who used to reside in Chicago and an expert lawyer.

Kuan Hui is a wraith that resides in the house that her foreign lover had given her and in which she died. She searches for the son that was taken from her among the wraith population of Hong Kong. She is a Censor in charge of reaping new wraiths for the Jade Emperor.
Lady Aine is a Seelie Sidhe Wilder of House Dougal in the Kingdom of Pacifica.
Kuros, was a former god of the Long-lost Atlantean Pantheon .
Lady Vadislava is one of the Sabbat elders attributed with developing the Path of Death and the Soul.
The Lady in Red is an angel whose purpose is to cause two targets to fall in love.

The Lady of Life Beyond Death, also known simply as the Lady of Death was a supernatural being that created the Great Bargain that would come to protect the Lost of the Hellenistic world during the time of the Web of Seven. She, for unknown reason, gave it to Nineveh, who had bartered it to the Lost for free access through the Hedge into the mortal world. Following Persephone's attempts to capture Mausolus, there was some debate among the Dream Builders as to whether the True Fae was, in fact, the Lady of Death.
The Lake-Spirit is a spirit from a SAS Scene - The Dead Lake from the Forsaken Chronicler's Guide. It is a contaminated spirit from all the corpses that have been deposited into it over many years.
Kshitigarbha is a Scourge in Los Angeles. Kshitigarbha is possessing the body of a mortal known as Isaiah Lincoln.
Kurttikeya is a Devourer in Los Angeles. Kurttikeya is possessing the body of a mortal known as Moco.
L'Enfant Perdu is the Malkavian Prince of Antwerp during the Medieval era.
"Lobo" Larry Vasquez is a tenth generation Gangrel and the sire of Gustavo Morales. He wanders the wilderness of California.
Lady Joan is a Puppeteer who discovered how to use animals as conduits.
Lan Chen is an influential Brujah gang leader of the London Anarchs.
La Malinche is a fledgling Brujah antitribu operating in Mexico City.
Lord Leopold Valdemar was a 6th generation Lasombra and a part of the Conspiracy of Isaac. He is now currently a wraith
Dame Lillian is a Seelie Nocker Wilder and Noble of House Beaumayn.
Lightning Ferrara is a Storm Lord Ithaeur member of the Echoes of Thunder Pack in Colorado.
Leandra Silken Smiler is a Shadow Lord and a Society of Nidhogg member.
Lee Carmody is a Cult of Ecstasy barabbi Mage employee of the Midnight Circus. He is part of the Fourth Circle.

Leufruy of Provence is a seventh generation Ventrue from Medieval France, and the childe of Lucius Trebius Rufus, the Prince of Jerusalem. He was diablerized along with his sire during the Anarch Revolt.
Lester Vance is a seventh generation Tremere and the childe of Mistress Fanchon, a founding member of the Camarilla.
Lester Giles is a Son of Ether barabbi Mage and member of the Watchers of the Void cabal of Drachus Vachar.
Father Li T'ien is a Wu Lung mage living in San Francisco's Chinatown where he supports the local Chinese immigrant community.
Lenelle is a Hecata Samedi and voodoo priestess of Birmingham.
Lili Zhou is a Bone Flower Mandarin of the New Promise Mandarinate in San Francisco.
Liu Shao is a cross-dressing Kuei-jin affiliated with the Sublime Caretakers wu of Hong Kong. Shao resides with the boat people in the Harbour.

The Little Tailor of Prague, also known as The Butcher of Prague, is an Old World Tzimisce adept of fleshcrafting war ghouls, a practice that has earned him a truly sinister reputation among his Sabbat peers.

, Rahu Blood Talon member of the Lodge of the Black Woods]]For more than half a century now, the Lodge of the Black Woods (or as they call themselves, the Sippe des Schwarzen Walder) has kept dominion over a swath of southwestern Germany. The lodge members have effectively resisted attacks from the Pure, coordinated multi-pack hunts against the Hosts and the Ridden and done what they can to keep humans from overrunning their most sacred places. The spirit that watches over the Lodge of the Black Woods is a wolf-spirit of shadowy, empty form called Wolf-That-Walks-Behind.
, Bone Shadow Ithaeur member of the Lodge of Kletby]] The Lodge of Kletby is a lodge concerned with the mechanics of curses.
, Blood Talon Irraka member of the Lodge of the Red Sands]] The Lodge of the Red Sands is a werewolf lodge found mostly in desert regions.
Lillian Pickering-Smith is a Wolf-blooded member of the Pickering Family Pack in Colorado.
Lisa Radcliffe is an artist of middling talent who intuitively paints the Shadow.

Lisl Eyes-of-the-Forest-and-Knower-of-Secrets is a Lupus Theurge Get of Fenris that was a former wolf-ghoul of the now deceased Tremere elder, Louis Pettigrass. She is the Master of the Rite for the Sept of the Mountain Watch.
Liu Aihan, also known by her deed-name "Returning Maiden", is a Chinese Galestalker who has broken the boundaries of auspice and is now a controversial figure among Garou worldwide.
Lo-ruhamah is a Fiend in Los Angeles. Lo-ruhamah is possessing a mortal known as Katherine Roggenkamp.
Livia da Ravenna is a seventh generation Ventrue and the Prince of Ravenna during the Dark Ages. She was commanded by her sire Aristophokles to diablerize him and take his place as ruler of the city.
Livia Antonia is a fifth generation Lasombra and a powerful methuselah, sire to Foulques.
The Lion of God is a spirit helper or spirit of Benevolence.

Lord Clouster was a Khan Bastet who lived during the 1800s. He and Sultan Jampal, a fellow Khan Bastet, caused Clouster's Purge. Clouster was an English Khan who tossed his own kuasha beneath the wheels of a train, fed his wife to a suttee fire by pretending to be dead, then killed his children when he found they did not carry the Changing Touch. He began the war with Jampal which ended with Clouster's execution by silver needles. By the time Clouster's Purge ended, the tensions between the Indians and the English had risen high enough to frighten tigers.

Lord Rackbur was a Khan Bastet that entered into a conflict with Sultan Amir Nagda. Both sides fell to darkness, Lord Rackbur enlisted Kindred allies to fight against Sultan Amir Nagda. While the Sultan used dark spirits against Rackbur's forces.
Lucinda Wester is a sixth generation Tzimisce and a childe of Dracula.
Lukasz Brancoveanu was a sixth generation Tzimisce and a childe of Noriz.
Lucas Halton is a prominent member of the Tremere clan and the Prince of Houston, Texas.
Lord Steel, the Duke of Hate, is a Maeljin Incarna of Abhorra, the Urge Wyrm of Hatred.
Luke Argent is a heavily-conflicted fetch whose changeling has not yet confronted him.
Lunes are moon spirits, emissaries of Luna, who interact on her behalf with the Forsaken.
Luther Black is a radical Lasombra vampire-priest of Vienna during the Dark Ages.
Louis Pettigrass was a powerful Tremere Elder residing in Chattanooga. He was the regnant of the lupine wolf-ghoul Lisl Eyes-of-the-Forest-and-Knower-of-Secrets.
Louis Doumer Millerand is a powerful Tremere who were among the first outsiders to discover West African blood magic in 1794.
Lucius is a Lasombra elder of the Dark Ages and the Cainite Heresy's representative in Lincoln.
Ludwig Falk is an eighth generation Tremere and the sire of Jasmin Rieckman.

Malcolm is a thirteenth generation Gangrel neonate, and the childe of Dietric. He is a former narcotics officer who now fed on drug-induced kine. As a Psychopomp, he helped ferry other Kindred safely across the Goblin Roads.
Madeline Coventry was the founder of Boston's Salem Chantry and one of the first Tremere within the New World.
Malacar is an Unseelie Satyr Grump and former Seer to Duke Aeon.
Mad Al, who escaped Bedlam alongside his double, is the fetch of Sir Alistair.
Mahanaga Visparakni was a Wan Xian who gained infamy for being the first akuma.

Magda Dodon is a Tzimisce koldun of the Lui Domien. She claims a refinery as her domain and seeks an alchemist partner to investigate deleteric blood and the possibilities of even worse industrial poisons.
Macario Zobel de Ayala is an autarkis ancilla (based on his Disciplines and general disposition, most likely a Toreador) inhabiting Bellium University.

Makareta-sherit is an eighth generation Setite of the Dark Ages, and the sire of Jean-Batiste de Montrond. She was part of the Temple of Set in Messina as it was targeted by hired Assamites and embraced the rogue crusader Jean-Batiste in an attempt to protect it, although he later fled to Paris.
Makarios, known as the Seducer, is a vampire of the Toreador clan.
Marc de Brabant is a Gangrel merchant prince, who acts as a shadow prince of sorts for various domains in the United States.
Marissa was the Tremere Prince of Washington, D.C. until her assassination in 1968 CE.
Mark Hallward Gillan is a mage and the signature character of the Order of Hermes.
Mariel St. John is a 9th generation Ventrue antitribu, a Sabbat spy operating under the nose of Baron Louis Fortier of Los Angeles.
Dr. Marcus Jackson is a Euthanatos mage who works as a university professor.
Marie Laveau, an Eshu, is a self-proclaimed member of the Shadow Court and the "Voodoo Queen of New Orleans."
Maria D'Agostino was a Lasombra active in the Levant during the Dark Medieval. An ambitious agent of her Elders, she sought to secure Lasombra prominence in the Holy Land.
Mama Polari is a 12th generation Brujah singer. She is one of several Ready-Made Player Characters found in V20 Ready Made Characters.

Marcos Belegrad is the Toreador Prince of Bogota. The sole Prince in Colombia, he holds enough financial and political sway in Bogota that even the non-Camarilla clans are forced to listen when he makes a demand. Four attempts to end the prince’s existence have all met with failure, and even the Setites are reportedly impressed by the prince's ability to avoid Final Death.
Maria Chin was a Tremere of Baltimore. The Toreador Victoria Ash witnessed the assassin Parmenides decapitating her with a garrote, ending her unlife.
Marianne Dupuy is a ninth generation Tremere in The Fief of the North.
Margaret "Peg" Woffington (1714-1760) is a hierarch wraith of the skeletal legion.
Marchesa Liliana is a prominent Hecata of the Harbingers of Skulls, and the wearer of the Triple-Faced Mask.
Marion Black is an Invictus Gangrel and the Sheriff of Seattle.
Mariah Haige is a sixth generation Tremere elder and the sire of Zachariah Shale.
Marcel of Dreux was a French Tremere and member of House Goratrix during the Dark Ages.

Mambo Asogwe Garcelle is a mortal in Haiti during the "The Dead Walk" events. She is the leader of the Mambo of St. Mary and the Petwo, a group of Catholic Vodouists based in Port-au-Prince. She possesses True Faith and leads her followers in a campaign against the Samedi, whom they see as a dangerous corruption of their faith.

Maxwell Anderson Mercer is the founder of the Æon Society. Along with his friend Michael Daemon Donighal he received his powers as a result of the Hammersmith Incident. In the Aberrant Era, Mercer is described as a paramorph, and possessing the nearly unique ability to travel through time. As time goes on, although how Mercer goes about traveling through time may be unique to him, others (specifically novas) will learn their own ways of how to move about through time. Mercer's time-travelling abilities are somewhat unstable; he is able to appear at a particular time period through force of will, but at least initially he was "unstuck in time", leading to him bouncing to various points in the
Mathieu Zweidler is the Proxy of the Vitakinetics, the Æsculapian Order, in the Trinity Universe.
Mary Johnson is a former Garou kinfolk turned into a Sabbat vampire.
Matron Violetta was a 6th generation Nosferatu. She was a part of the Conspiracy of Isaac.
María Sandoza is a Lasombra who has been the Grand Inquisitor of the Sabbat since 1973.
Mary Campbell is a Homid Ahroun Silver Fang from House Austere Howl.
Mateo Serrano is a twelfth-generation Toreador or Banu Haqim fledgling associated with the Camarilla.

Mary Singer was a prominent tenth-generation Ventrue elder of Washington, D.C., and the sire of Gino Manitelli. With Prince Marissa's permission, she Embraced Gino to serve the Camarilla as an enforcer against the Giovanni incursions. Not long after, Mary was destroyed.

Matthias Van Dorn is a powerful American Ventrue and the mastermind behind his city, using political connections to manipulate and control the domain. Although he wasn't a Prince, he is a major investor, captain of industry, and the largest political contributor in the domain. During a political gathering, he had his employee Casper Johnson bring him politicians to convince and manipulate, until Casper was attacked by his rival Ventrue Joachin Almodovar. His assistant Spencer neutralized Joachin and brought him before Matthias for interrogation. Matthias ended his rival's unlife by diablerizing him and then Embraced the shocked Casper.

Maximarius is a sixth generation Brujah and the sire of Lilika Kairos. Cruel in nature, he Embraced Lilika in Florence, as an expedient solution to the pursuing hunters after him. He left his childe right there, to fend for herself, and she would later become one of the original Archons of the Camarilla.
Mary Lou "Bitch Queen" Vannoy is a Hollow One Mage of the Children of Lilith (aka Lilith's Kids) Cabal of the Sepulcher.

McKade is a Brujah of the London Camarilla. He is one of the few remaining Camarilla Brujah and is present in the party previous to the Fall of London. There, he spins an impressive tale of brutally taking on a group of five hunters and tearing them to pieces. McKade is a braggart and will usually meet even social conflict physically.
Louis-René Maucroix is an eighth generation Tremere in the Fief of the North.
Mathilde of Provence, once known as Iolana Aelius, is a Roman Ventrue diablerist and the Prince of medieval Le Mans.
Marta was a Malkavian antitribu of Madrid and the new Ductus of the Salamanca Lords.

Meerlinda of Wessex was one of the seven founders of the vampiric faction of House Tremere that later became Clan Tremere. She had a large part in the creation of the Camarilla, although Meerlinda's efforts were mostly disguised as Etrius's ideas.
Mercedes Gonzaga de Ortiz was an Euthanatos mage during the 19th century. She was reborn as Amanda Jonsson.
Michael Wyndham is an ensorcelled mortal obsessed with fairy tales.
Michael George is a Lupus Galliard Wendigo Caern Warder of the Sept of the Painted Sands.

Michael Simmons is the founder of the Denver-based therapy and intervention group Healing Hands, in Colorado. He has experienced the First Change, but due to help from an ancient spirit and drugs, is in denial of his werewolf nature.
Merika Seth is an Orphan Mage from San Francisco, California.
Menard is a Lasombra and the Sabbat Archbishop of Nicaragua.
Michal Czajkowski (1808-1886) is a hierarch wraith of the skeletal legion.

Medina bint Augustin is a seventh generation Lasombra of the Qabilat al-Khayal, and the sire of Ordonio de Toledo. She found Ordonio in Toledo on a trip to Seville and was attracted to his depth of knowledge and excellent memory. After Embracing him, Medina and her childe joined the Ashirra.
Milarepa is a Fifth Generation methuselah of the rare Children of Osiris bloodline.
Mockmaw of the Wyrm was a legendary Black Spiral Dancer chieftain.
Mihail of Sinai was a Nosferatu that was part of a cult that worshipped the Nosferatu Antediluvian.

Mnesis, also called the Memory by the Mokolé, is a trait possessed only by werereptiles, including the Mokolé themselves and rare cases among the Nagah. It consists in accessing the user's ancestors' memories.
Mien or Fae mien is a changeling or other fae’s true form, which is concealed by the mask.

Midori Saputo is the regent of one of Japan's Beast Courts. She is friends with Kumiko Hadoki. Midori forbade Kumiko from interfering with the Otanaga Power Plant due to its economic importance, despite the risk posed by its nuclear power plant. Nevertheless, she knew Kumiko was responsible for shutting it down. Because Kumiko acted without official permission, Midori was able to save face. It is not clear what sort of shapeshifter Midori is.
Minister Thorn, also known as Sammael the Thorn, is a Stranger who takes the form of a priestly figure.

Modian was a Nosferatu of 8th generation who had been turned into a wight by Jasper Knowles' dark experiments. He's a childe of a powerful elder Reremouse and Dove's sire. Prince Lettow described Modian as a master of shadow arts who helped in creation of Elysium in Tucson.
Mnemovores are a form of non-Kindred vampire that feeds on memories.

Miranda Corliss was a vampire targeted by a Strix. She let the Owl in for two months for the purpose of laying low her sister, Phaedra, whom Corliss feared would bring harm to their sire, the Prince. Unfortunately, while wearing her body, the Strix attacked and left for dead said sire, emboldening Phaedra. Before she could do anything further, Corliss was killed by a Strix-hunting vampire named Jorge.
Mikey Wu is a Iron Master Irraka member of the Ratcatchers pack in Chicago.
Mirri al-Lam'a is a seventh generation Lasombra and the Prince of Sirte until 2011.
Mirri al-Lam'a is a seventh generation Lasombra and the Prince of Sirte, in Libya, until the .
Moiratha is a Devourer in Los Angeles. Moiratha is possessing the body of the mortal known as Carmen Parigi.
Moise is a Setite cult leader in Montreal and the childe of High Priest Jérar. The discovery of his Blood Cult by the Sabbat led to the sect war between Ghede's Setites and the Sabbat in the city.

Mother Pasta is a Homid Ragabash Bone Gnawer. She moved to Australia from Calabria, Italy with her parents in the late 1940s. Unbeknownst to everyone but herself she has become unhinged from the death of her husband, and her love of pasta has been replaced with a craving for human flesh. It is only a matter of time before she acts on these urges.
Mordecai is a Seelie Sluagh Wilder in the Kingdom of Pacifica.
Mr Smiles, also known as Doctor Samuel Miles, was a changeling serial killer and kidnapper who preyed upon Victorian London.
Mortimer is a Seelie Sluagh Wilder from the Kingdom of Pacifica.
The Most Serene Black Pearl Mistress, Mother of Shadows is a Bone Flower.
Morgaine is a powerful eighth generation Toreador elder of the New Orleans Camarilla.
Nathaniel Simmons is a Gangrel Archon that is well known for his eagerness to participate in Blood Hunts.
The Lasombra currently known as the Nabatean, is one of the last of the and has spent thousand years staked in a coffin as a Kindred attraction until he reemerged during the in 2011.
Namm-Dar is an Auspice of the Uratha associated with the stellar eclipse.

The Naga were a race of magic-immune snake-people who inhabited the Himalayas prior to and during the . During the waning days of Alexander the Great's empire, they were discovered by a sorcerer named Xenon who coveted the artifacts and lore they guarded. As such, they drove him out. The ultimate fate of these beings is unknown, as is their possible association with the Naga Kingdom whose heritage the Mantra Sadhaki claim.

Nazirah is a Sorcerer Caste Assamite of the Dark Ages, known as the "Assamite Witch" of Granada, Spain. The Assamite Salim Al-Ahzan gathered information in the European vampire courts, which he passed on to her.
Nantothijah is a Malefactor in Los Angeles. Nantothijah is possessing the body of a mortal known as Jack Fetch.
Nagrogasto the Mandragora is a Demonic Spirit. Note: This is a Demon before the Demon: The Fallen game setting.
Nhudri the Grand High Artificer was an ancient wraith rescued from the Labyrinth by Charon. Nhudri brought with him the secrets of soulforging, the skill to convert wraithly plasm into useful items.
Ninsun, also called the Visage of Patterns, is one of the Apocalyptic Forms available to the Fallen, specifically those of the House of Neberu who specialize in the Lore of Patterns.
Nightmaster is an insane Shadow Lord who lives in the Abyss.

Nhaukh is a Black Spiral Dancer Theurge of the Dragon's Daughter Pack. He has prophesied that his packmate, Zhyzhak, will crush the last Gaian King under her heel in the Apocalypse. This is generally presumed to mean Jonas Albrecht.
Nikolai Eyes-of-Shadow was a Shadow Lord Philodox who lived during the Dark Ages.
Nocnitsa, or Noctnitsa, are animate chimera born from nightmares.
Night hags are Incubi who drain Glamour and Willpower from their victims.
Nibbles the Clown is a Horror that steals its victims' faces.
Night's Call to Arms is a Hunter in Darkness Elodoth alpha of the Shadow of Smoke and Fire Pack in Colorado.

Noelle Cameron is a sixth generation Tremere and the Regent of Zanzibar, Tanzania. She rules one of the world's largest chantries and answers only to Councilor Elaine de Calinot, the Tremere ruler of Africa. She also owns and supervises the Tremere school known as "Café Zanzibar" on the island.

Nicolao is a Lasombra and the Prince of Tyre, who ruled nominally the Baali-dominated ancient city. He is in fact working for the methuselah Tanit and surveys a network of ship captains secretly at the service of the Baali's name.
Nevesa Zekistraya is a Tzimisce of the Old Clan Tzimisce faction, based in Detroit. From there, she uses the Kerberos Caitiffs and the local drug cartels to weaken the enemies of the Old Clan.
Noriz was a Tzimisce vampire of the Old Country and renowned for his cruelty and hunger for power. He was Voivode among Voivodes, before the time of Vladimir Rustovich.
Nuaella is a Seelie (barely) Sidhe Wilder of House Fiona on the island of O'ahu in Hawaii.
The protagonist of Loom of Fate, Norna Weaver is a 15-year old Hollow One orphan with a foreboding destiny and a powerful avatar.
Néstor Lavagna is a powerful Lasombra and the Sabbat Bishop of Mendoza, Argentina.

Oliver Ligon was a seventh generation Ventrue. One of the few Kindred who managed to Embrace a werewolf, creating Pariah the Abomination in 1860. Oliver was allied with Maxwell in Chicago, but was killed by Lodin's men.
Near the heart of Arcadia, the Old Man rules his Well of Tears, capturing and stabling a myriad of Darkling servants.
Old Middy is a True Fae hag who represents the death of the young.
Orson "Graveseeker" Gravely is a rank 4 Homid Bone Gnawer Theurge.
